translationRepairs: The Founder sent his nephew Guo Wen Zheng and his nephew Li Wenzhong with gifts of gold and brocade to Qin's home to invite him.
The Founder sent his nephew Wen Zheng and his sister's son Li Wenzhong with gifts of gold and brocade to Qin's home to invite him.

s0040 names 從子文正 and 甥李文忠. 文正 has no surname Guo, and 甥 is a sister's son, so collapsing both men into undifferentiated 'nephews' and inventing Guo is a real error; the replacement restores both kinship terms.
At that time the Founder had already secured Ningbo and Shaoxing and was planning to seize the domains of Zhang Shicheng and Fang Guozhen.
At that time the Founder had already secured Ningyue and was planning to seize Zhang Shicheng and Fang Guozhen.

s0054 已定寧越 is the single place Ningyue, not Ningbo and Shaoxing. 規取張士誠、方國珍 names those men as the planned objects of attack; the replacement corrects the invented place split without adding unsupported geography.
With its armies and wealth behind you, you will conquer when you attack and stand firm when you defend—what can Chaghan do against you?
With its armies and wealth behind you, you will conquer when you attack and stand firm when you defend—what can even a hundred Chaghans do against us?
s0064 百察罕能如吾何哉 is hyperbolic 'a hundred Chaghans' against first-person 吾. The original drops 百 and turns 吾 into 'you'; the replacement restores both.
When the Founder's army was at Chuzhou, he came to the camp leaning on his staff.
When the Founder's army was at Chuzhou, he took his riding crop and presented himself at the camp.
s0116 杖策謁軍門 is the idiom of taking a riding whip to present oneself at headquarters, not leaning on a walking staff. The replacement restores that sense.
When the Founder's army was at Chu, leaning on his staff he visited the army gate.
When the Founder's army was at Chu, taking up his riding crop he visited the army gate.
The same 杖策 is taking up a riding crop, not leaning on a staff. The proposed literal corrects the verb.
Fan always governed with simplicity and ease, raised schools, and comforted the people.
Chang governed with simplicity and ease, raised schools, and comforted the people.
In s0131 常以簡易為治, 常 is Fan Chang's given name as subject, parallel to the biography's 范常. Reading it as the adverb 'always' is a real error.
Fan Chang, style name Ziquan, was a man of Chu.
Fan Chang, style name Ziquan, was a man of Chuzhou.
滁人 is a native of Chuzhou (滁), confirmed by the next unit 太祖軍滁. Rendering 滁 as the ancient state Chu is a place-name error.
s0190 Chinese is the editorial wrapper 〈（李夢庚）〉 around the appended name. The stray ]〉 in the idiomatic English is markup leakage, not part of the heading.
The literal English copies the same wrapper debris. A clean parenthetical '(Li Menggeng)' matches the glossed name inside 〈（…）〉.
While Xie Zaixing was defending Zhuzhou, one of his subordinates traded privately across the border into Wu territory.
While Xie Zaixing was defending Zhuquan, one of his subordinates traded privately across the border into Wu territory.
s0204 守諸全 is Zhuquan, not Zhuzhou. The replacement restores the garrison name.
When Xie Zaixing was defending Zhuzhou, a subordinate general privately traded across the Wu border.
When Xie Zaixing was defending Zhuquan, a subordinate general privately traded across the Wu border.
The literal line repeats the same 諸全/Zhuzhou error; Zhuquan is the correct romanization.
The Founder had the subordinate executed in anger, summoned Xie to admonish him, and sent Li Menggeng to Zhuzhou to take overall command of the army.
The Founder had the subordinate executed in anger, summoned Xie to admonish him, and sent Li Menggeng to Zhuquan to take overall command of the army.
s0205 往諸全總制軍事 again names Zhuquan. Replacing Zhuzhou with Zhuquan corrects the place.
The Founder in anger killed the subordinate general, summoned and instructed Zaixing, and ordered Menggeng to go to Zhuzhou as overall controller of military affairs.
The Founder in anger killed the subordinate general, summoned and instructed Zaixing, and ordered Menggeng to go to Zhuquan as overall controller of military affairs.
The literal of s0205 likewise mistranslates 諸全 as Zhuzhou; Zhuquan is required.
s0238 is the wrapper 〈（阮弘道）〉. The idiomatic ']〉' is leftover editorial punctuation and should be stripped.
The literal heading has the same markup residue; '(Ruan Hongdao)' is the complete English form of the parenthetical name.
Generals of the Central Plains—Boluo seized troops and violated the palace, violated ethics and rebelled against order; his conduct has already been extinguished.
Generals of the Central Plains—Boluo seized troops and violated the palace, violating ethics and transgressing order; he has already been wiped out.
s0299 行已夷滅 means Boluo (or his line) has already been destroyed. Rendering 行 as 'conduct' that was 'extinguished' invents an abstract moral ending the Chinese does not state.
Köke held the crown prince hostage and raised arms, was urgent about private enmity, and had no will to resist the foreign foe.
Köke held the crown prince hostage and raised arms, was urgent about private enmity, and had no will of righteous anger against the common foe.

無敵愾之志 is lack of shared righteous anger against the common enemy, so 'foreign foe' is a real error. The proposal's 'will of shared hatred' is awkward; this revision keeps the accurate 急私仇 calque and restores 敵愾.
Although one may say it was heaven's gift, was it not also that left and right ministers and assistants had many nation-gifted scholars to help?
Although one may say it was heaven's gift, was it not also that the ministers and assistants at his left and right included many outstanding men of the state to help?
s0314 國士 are outstanding men of the state, not 'nation-gifted scholars', and 左右丞弼 are ministers at his side. The replacement matches those senses.
